claim:paphos-firmware-cycle.falsifier: After deploy, a staged kernel or pending capsule is not booted within a day, or the journal shows 'Outside of configured reboot window, skipping.' at a 05:00 run.

intent:change_01M6E7P7D9Q3A9P14KBZEFS8VC.raw_intent:
Sign every commit and tag on every den host: programs.git.signing (SSH) on M-02877, no host breaks

Owner (worldofgeese) mandates signed commits and tags everywhere. den writes ~/.config/git/config with gpg.format=ssh, but modules/M-02877/dktaohan.nix nests signing.{signByDefault,key} under programs.git.settings, so git gets an inert [signing] section and never signs; M-02877 relies on a ~/.gitconfig stopgap (user.signingkey ~/.ssh/my_ssh_key.pub, commit.gpgsign, tag.gpgsign, gpg.ssh.allowedSignersFile ~/.ssh/allowed_signers). Make den own it through home-manager programs.git.signing (key, signByDefault, format ssh) plus signing.allowedSigners, only on hosts that hold the key; keep mahakala's OpenPGP signing; paphos, oracle and pixel-fold unchanged. Checks: just dagger-check, just check, M-02877 darwin build (no switch), drvPath comparison for other hosts. Plain decapod validate: only DecapodLabs/decapod#1474 may fail (owner-approved). Signed commits only. Tracked in AEC bead aec-trv.

deferred_questions: pixel-fold holds only ~/.ssh/id_ed25519, which is not a GitHub signing key. To sign there, the owner must register a signing key for it. Out of scope for this PR.

programs.git.settings in modules/M-02877/dktaohan.nix also writes an inert [aliases] section (git reads [alias]) and lfs.enable (not programs.git.lfs.enable). This PR does not change them.
plan.intent: The owner (worldofgeese) wants a signature on every commit and tag. den writes ~/.config/git/config with gpg.format=ssh, but modules/M-02877/dktaohan.nix puts signing.{signByDefault,key} inside programs.git.settings. So git gets an inert [signing] section and does not sign. M-02877 signs only because of a ~/.gitconfig stopgap. Change: M-02877 gets the Home Manager options programs.git.signing (format ssh, key ~/.ssh/my_ssh_key.pub, signByDefault true) and programs.git.signing.allowedSigners with the line of the stopgap. mahakala keeps its OpenPGP signing. paphos, oracle and pixel-fold get no signing, because they do not hold the key. No deploy, no switch, and no edit of ~/.gitconfig. Bead aec-trv in the AEC bead store.

Pinned home-manager 095fef2 (modules/programs/git.nix) offers programs.git.signing.{key,format,signByDefault,signer,allowedSigners}. signByDefault sets commit.gpgSign and tag.gpgSign. allowedSigners writes $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/git/allowed_signers and sets gpg.ssh.allowedSignersFile. format ssh sets gpg.format and gpg.ssh.program (nixpkgs openssh ssh-keygen).

The deployed ~/.config/git/config on M-02877 has [signing] key and signbydefault (inert: git reads no signing.* keys). git config --show-origin: user.signingkey, commit.gpgsign, tag.gpgsign and gpg.ssh.allowedsignersfile come only from the ~/.gitconfig stopgap.

Deploy targets (modules/hosts.nix): M-02877/dktaohan includes gitcommon and holds ~/.ssh/my_ssh_key (programs.ssh github.com IdentityFile); the worldofgeese home (mahakala) already signs with OpenPGP 63D28F81460A224A (modules/worldofgeese.nix); paphos/kypris has no gitcommon; oracle has no Home Manager users; pixel-fold has its own nix-on-droid Home Manager with only ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.

Signing key form test (git 2.56.0, nixpkgs openssh 10.6p1 ssh-keygen): user.signingKey ~/.ssh/my_ssh_key.pub signs with the agent, with no agent, with an unreachable socket and with an empty agent. The literal public key fails without the agent (Couldn't get agent socket) and with an empty agent (Couldn't find key in agent), because git passes -U. So the key is the path.
